name: Complaint legal corpus search
description: Searches the combined federal and state-law corpus (US Code, Federal Register, state statutes, administrative rules) for documents that support complaint assertions. Returns authority citations with relevance scores and source URLs.

query.description: Natural-language query or assertion text to search for.

state.description: Optional two-letter US state code to include state-law results.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return per corpus section.
